=== classic ===
<?php
define('DB_NAME', 'woo_classic');
define('DB_PASSWORD', 'classic-secret-must-never-appear');
$table_prefix = 'wp_';
define('DISABLE_WP_CRON', true);

=== whitespace-and-double-quotes ===
<?php
define ( "DB_NAME" , "woo_custom" );
define ( "DB_PASSWORD" , "second-secret-must-never-appear" );
$table_prefix   = "shop_";
define ( "DISABLE_WP_CRON" , false );

=== const ===
<?php
const DB_NAME = 'woo_const';
const DB_PASSWORD = 'const-secret-must-never-appear';
const DISABLE_WP_CRON = true;
$table_prefix = 'network_2_';

=== environment ===
<?php
define('DB_NAME', getenv('WORDPRESS_DB_NAME'));
define('DB_PASSWORD', getenv('WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD'));
$table_prefix = 'env_';
define('DISABLE_WP_CRON', false);

=== multiline ===
<?php
define(
    'DB_NAME',
    'woo_multiline'
);
define('DB_PASSWORD', 'multiline-secret-must-never-appear');
$table_prefix =
    'multi_';
define(
    'DISABLE_WP_CRON',
    true
);
